classification.difficultyReason: Find missing signed integers in addition, subtraction and multiplication sentences; the final parts require evaluating both sides and identifying a missing factor.

answer.worked:
The starting number is 6 units left of 8: $8-6=2$.
$$2+6=8$$

Move 6 units right to zero, then 5 more units right. Add $6+5=11$.
$$-6+11=5$$

Move 3 units right from 12 to 15, so subtract $-3$.
$$\begin{align*}12-(-3)&=12+3\\12-(-3)&=15\end{align*}$$

Move 1 unit left from $-9$ to $-10$, so add $-1$.
$$\begin{align*}-9+(-1)&=-9-1\\-9+(-1)&=-10\end{align*}$$

Move 7 units right from 13 to 20, so subtract $-7$.
$$\begin{align*}13-(-7)&=13+7\\13-(-7)&=20\end{align*}$$

Move 10 units left to zero, then 1 more unit left. Subtract $10+1=11$.
$$10-11=-1$$

Move 1 unit right from 5 to 6, so subtract $-1$.
$$\begin{align*}5-(-1)&=5+1\\5-(-1)&=6\end{align*}$$

Move 5 units right from 2 to 7, so subtract $-5$.
$$\begin{align*}2-(-5)&=2+5\\2-(-5)&=7\end{align*}$$

Move 4 units right from $-1$ to 3, so subtract $-4$.
$$\begin{align*}-1-(-4)&=-1+4\\-1-(-4)&=3\end{align*}$$

Subtracting $-3$ moves 3 units right. Start 3 units left of 7: $7-3=4$.
$$\begin{align*}4-(-3)&=4+3\\4-(-3)&=7\end{align*}$$

Subtracting $-10$ moves 10 units right. Start 10 units left of 12: $12-10=2$.
$$\begin{align*}2-(-10)&=2+10\\2-(-10)&=12\end{align*}$$

Subtracting $-4$ moves 4 units right. Start 4 units left of $-20$: $-20-4=-24$.
$$\begin{align*}-24-(-4)&=-24+4\\-24-(-4)&=-20\end{align*}$$

Move 6 units right from 5 to 11, so subtract $-6$.
$$\begin{align*}5-(-6)&=5+6\\5-(-6)&=11\end{align*}$$

Subtracting $-2$ moves 2 units right. Start 2 units left of $-3$: $-3-2=-5$.
$$\begin{align*}-5-(-2)&=-5+2\\-5-(-2)&=-3\end{align*}$$

Move 2 units left from $-2$ to $-4$, so subtract 2.
$$-2-2=-4$$

Subtracting $-5$ moves 5 units right. Start 5 units left of $-1$: $-1-5=-6$.
$$\begin{align*}-6-(-5)&=-6+5\\-6-(-5)&=-1\end{align*}$$

Move 9 units right from 6 to 15, so subtract $-9$.
$$\begin{align*}6-(-9)&=6+9\\6-(-9)&=15\end{align*}$$

Subtracting $-2$ moves 2 units right. Start 2 units left of $-4$: $-4-2=-6$.
$$\begin{align*}-6-(-2)&=-6+2\\-6-(-2)&=-4\end{align*}$$

Move 3 units left from 2 to $-1$, so add $-3$.
$$\begin{align*}2+(-3)&=2-3\\2+(-3)&=-1\end{align*}$$

Move 3 units left to zero, then 7 more units left. Add $-(3+7)=-10$.
$$\begin{align*}3+(-10)&=3-10\\3+(-10)&=-7\end{align*}$$

Move 4 units left from $-2$ to $-6$, so add $-4$.
$$\begin{align*}-2+(-4)&=-2-4\\-2+(-4)&=-6\end{align*}$$

Adding $-3$ moves 3 units left. Start 3 units right of 1: $1+3=4$.
$$\begin{align*}4+(-3)&=4-3\\4+(-3)&=1\end{align*}$$

Adding $-10$ moves 10 units left. Start 10 units right of $-11$: $-11+10=-1$.
$$\begin{align*}-1+(-10)&=-1-10\\-1+(-10)&=-11\end{align*}$$

$4$ and $-4$ form zero pairs.
$$\begin{align*}4+(-4)&=4-4\\4+(-4)&=0\end{align*}$$

Adding $-3$ moves 3 units left. Start 3 units right of 2: $2+3=5$.
$$\begin{align*}5+(-3)&=5-3\\5+(-3)&=2\end{align*}$$

Adding $-6$ moves 6 units left. Start 6 units right of $-1$: $-1+6=5$.
$$\begin{align*}5+(-6)&=5-6\\5+(-6)&=-1\end{align*}$$

Move 1 unit left from $-2$ to $-3$, so add $-1$.
$$\begin{align*}-2+(-1)&=-2-1\\-2+(-1)&=-3\end{align*}$$

$$-2\times15=-30$$
The product is negative and 5 is positive, so the missing factor is negative. Its magnitude is $30\div5=6$.
$$5\times(-6)=-30$$
The missing number is $-6$.

$$\begin{align*}-24-3&=-(24+3)\\-24-3&=-27\end{align*}$$
The product is negative and $-3$ is negative, so the missing factor is positive. Its magnitude is $27\div3=9$.
$$-3\times9=-27$$
The missing number is $9$.

$$\begin{align*}-40+4&=-36\\-2\times6&=-12\end{align*}$$
The product is negative and the known factors have a negative product, so the missing factor is positive. Its magnitude is $36\div12=3$.
$$\begin{align*}-2\times3\times6&=-6\times6\\-2\times3\times6&=-36\end{align*}$$
The missing number is $3$.
